Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files."}}'   || true ;; esac

python3 -c "
import json, sys, subprocess, re
try:
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
except:
    sys.exit(0)
cmd = d.get('tool_input', d).get('command', '')
if not re.search(r'(^|[;&|]+)\\s*git commit', cmd):
    sys.exit(0)
if "<<'EOF'" not in cmd:
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': '\u274c git commit direct bloqu\u00e9. Ce projet requiert : (1) mettre \u00e0 jour .changeset/*.md, (2) lancer les quality checks. Utilise /git-commit.'}}))
    sys.exit(2)
r = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only'], capture_output=True, text=True)
lines = r.stdout.splitlines()
published = [l for l in lines if l.startswith('libs/') or l.startswith('apps/')]
changeset = [l for l in lines if l.startswith('.changeset/')]
if published and not changeset:
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': '\u274c Changeset non mis \u00e0 jour ! Packages modifi\u00e9s : ' + ', '.join(published)}}))
    sys.exit(2)
"
